@everyone — charity stream for the linden community pantry, sat nov 21, 10am to 10pm

posting this early and pinning it. last year we raised $212 and half the server didnt even know it was happening bc i posted it the thursday before, so this year im putting it up now and the goal is $600.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
every dollar goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off, and through their wholesale partner every $1 is about 4 pounds of food. they serve around 340 families a week and the shelves are the lowest theyve been before thanksgiving. so even $3 helps, and if you cant give more thats genuinely fine, dont feel bad about it.

rook is matching the first $100, so donate early and it counts double.

incentives
$100 — i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and i do it on stream
$400 — one hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry arranges

its not begging if you get hair dye content out of it lol

no card? you can still help. the pantry takes canned and boxed food at the blue bin by the side door, saturdays 9 to 1, and sharing the link counts too.

first half is community lobbies, ill drop the code, then chat votes the game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps larry.

and @sk8rpaige — no card needed. you can bring canned or boxed food to the blue bin by the side door saturdays 9 to 1, or just share the link with people whove got a card. either way it helps.
